common: MANDATORY: Work only on billy-dev; source /home/lubko/.profile before Antonina. Do not print the entire board: use python3 /home/lubko/soring301/scripts/board_digest.py --recent 7 (optionally --contains or --page N). Research goal is UNIFORM complexity of exact S(n) and SORT-BOUND-U, not ordinary sorting, generic poset hardness, or superficial finite lemmas. Read AGENTS.md and docs/problem.md. State one falsifiable all-n claim and its concrete complexity implication, independently try to refute it, consult primary literature, and report precise uncertainty. NO new Lean unless a substantial already-validated all-n theorem is ripe for kernel verification. Do not create a PR, change main, or post another board comment unless an independently checked theorem/falsification truly changes the research picture. If no result, say no result and why. Board posts must redirect --json output to a file rather than flood tool context.

sYIEgoMgv7GpA2M8IF6N55-race: Optimal YES certificates, all n. Try a polynomial-size proof-carrying framed query-DAG for height exactly S(n), not just merge sort or Sergeev. State transition correctness, n-dependence and the exact height verifier. Test concrete candidate 'small unresolved interfaces' against n=5 root-prefix sibling obstruction; prove or refute an ALL-n structural reduction before claiming NP. Source Stober and Weiss (ALENEX 2023) and Sergeev (ECCC 2020).

Optimal-strategy automata. Search for a root-specific equivalence of partial-order histories STRONGER than relabelled-poset isomorphism that preserves all legal next comparisons, both child outcomes and height. Define a finite-state congruence and locally checkable edge frames. Find a superpolynomial counterfamily if it cannot be polynomially complete. Do not assume a general-poset hardness result transfers to unary S(n).
uocSY7i9UxaE71ujhhxl5t-strict: Complexity-class certificate audit. The n-key sorter may have a short program, but checking its worst-case comparison budget is coNP-hard in broad always-correct program models. Seek a genuinely NP-verifiable locally proof-carrying policy language with sound frame composition. Its completeness must cover ALL optimal n-sorters. Distinguish from Σ2 certificates and nonuniform advice; provide an exact implication for SORT-BOUND-U or a falsifiable obstruction.

Root-optimal conditional compression. Study whether a height-S(n) decision tree can be reorganized so every reachable state is locally minimax without increasing the number of distinct framed nodes. The n=6 DAG counterexample defeats naive local repairs. Seek an all-n global normalization proof or concrete scalable family disproving it; finite experiments only if they falsify an explicit all-n conjecture.
kK0hfvyCDUbSg5chSWjR9H-friant: Uniform coNO lower-bound certificates beyond log2(e(P)). Design a NONADDITIVE, polynomially checkable adversary potential whose comparison rule gives a root bound strictly stronger than C(n)=ceil(log2 n!) on an infinite n-family, or show an exact no-go for a precise potential family. The additive extension-weight dual cannot exceed e(P). Stober-Weiss n=12/28 are finite tests only. No Lean.

Root comparison transcript constraints. Adjacent-pair witness J(P,pi) and entropy-count lower bounds alone fail to distinguish n=12 obstructing states. Propose a succinct path/edge-cover invariant with polynomial-time verification and induction over every allowed query. Seek a symbolic all-n strengthening, not repetition of the finite n12 lower-bound census.
z8FIxKzTS8NklpFKEez6hS-equality: Exact root-prefix reachability all n. For a target poset P and transcript h of length d, R_h(P)=max(d+F(P), max_i i+F(Q_i^sibling)). We verified n=5 C2 ordinal A3 has d+F=S(5) yet min_h R_h=8>S(5)=7. Find an efficient, history-independent certificate for R(P)>k or an infinite root-relevant family with a sharp polynomial obstruction; do not confuse shortest transcript with optimal-sorter reachability.

Entropy-balance conditional necessity. Verify E[sum(1-h2(p_i))]=E[depth]-log2(n!) and Sergeev epsilon(n)=o(n), hence typical optimal-sorter path has o(n) constant-imbalanced queries. Try to turn this expected-path constraint into a SOUND deterministic worst-case pruning rule using a locally computable potential, and falsify the simplest local rule. An average-case fact does not imply NP membership.
naVVa2aiGjj9EeQlYbAOTs-removing: Parameterization by additive surplus d=k-ceil(log2 n!). Investigate whether deciding exact S(n)<=C(n)+d admits an f(d)poly(n) algorithm or polynomial-depth kernel for fixed d, including d=0. Account for all comparator choices and siblings; avoid the false inference that d+F(P) characterizes viable root histories. Source Stober-Weiss 2023 and original exact decision-tree DP.

Optimal-viable state counting. Separate (a) budget-root-reachable, (b) e(P) information-admissible, (c) d+F(P) locally viable and (d) states on SOME root-optimal policy. Known 2^{Omega(n log^2 n)} height-two family is excluded even by information budget on optimal paths. Can an ALL-n superpolynomial lower or polynomial upper bound for set (d) be proved with a controlled family? Investigate explicit failure of criteria (a)-(c).
so7oeYESYOuat2aZ6bP0CY-hideous: Uniform complexity sharpness. SORT-BOUND-U in near-linear deterministic space and 2^{O(n log^2 n)} time is already established; seek a rigorously improved time or space bound for the special antichain root, not general-poset minimax. Attempt a true 2^{O(n log n)} exact evaluator via symmetry/pruning and falsify its proposed representation using information-admissible prime states.

Hardness under sparse unary encoding. Many-one NP hardness for SORT-BOUND-U would imply P=NP (Mahaney); NP/PSPACE adaptive Turing hardness would imply nonuniform hierarchy collapse. Find an encoding-faithful target for a meaningful unconditional lower bound or show a concrete barrier to a suggested hard reduction. Do NOT state sparse membership in P/poly as uniform P membership.
HS5LZJ7PvDr441nyS0bkje-dearest: Computable entropy-balance surrogates. The root-optimal entropy identity depends on ratios of linear extension counts; investigate Bubley-Dyer approximate extension-count sampling or later FPRAS and the 2025 Haeupler et al partial-information sorter. Can a polynomial-time approximate balancing oracle certify exact worst-case threshold or only a near-optimal upper bound? Prove a counterexample or an explicit conditional completeness theorem.

Exact partial-information sorting interfaces. For small disjoint chains and ordinal factors, establish sound, compositional ALL-n exact F(P) rules with polynomial verification, then test whether they can be glued into an optimal A_n root tree without losing global branch optimality. Reject simply transferring O(log e(P)) approximation as an exact equality.
grhT1CGQzErpmZ1DOIhoZY-mined: Independent all-n frontier referee. Verify the 7-key pair A=(0,0,1,3,5,5,37), B=(0,0,2,1,1,9,59) has e(A)=e(B)=60, F(A)=6,F(B)=7, and pairwise nonisomorphic incomparability-connected factors. Audit claimed 2^{Theta(n)} information-admissible local-NO ordinal sums, then check if they are trivially solvable by series decomposition and whether they are ever on an optimal root path. Report only NEW corrections with independent validation.

Independent theorem triage. Referee new Antonina #301 all-n assertions against their exact definitions, sources and uniform complexity consequences, prioritizing false isomorphism counts, unjustified optimal-branch transfer, bogus additive comparison lower bounds or ambiguity about polynomial verifier completeness. No repeated n5 gadget work. Post only a new counterexample or a solid all-n theorem.
